summary.text: Amber Hulse is a Republican state senator from South Dakota's District 30 and a lawyer who took office on January 14, 2025.
She advanced from the June 2, 2026, Republican primary and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Hulse was born in Spearfish, South Dakota, and graduated from Hot Springs High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of South Dakota in 2021 and a law degree from Georgetown Law in 2024.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said she grew up on her parents' ranch in Hot Springs and, after graduating from the University of South Dakota, served both Gov. Kristi Noem and President Donald Trump.
She also said she worked at an election law firm and for the U.S. Senate Judiciary Committee for Sen. Josh Hawley while taking night classes at Georgetown Law.
In the 2025-2026 session Hulse is vice chair of the Senate Judiciary Committee and a member of the Senate Taxation Committee.
In the 2024 survey, she listed election integrity, rising property taxes, and resources for law enforcement and first responders as key campaign messages.
